offering_description.value: Owns, manages and sells timberlands in the US South, Pacific Northwest and New Zealand. Grows and harvests timber and sells logs to mills and exporters. Also sells and leases land for real estate and other uses.

primary_products.value: softwood logs (sawtimber and pulpwood); standing timber; carbon and other natural resource products

primary_services.value: timberland management; real estate development and land sales; hunting and surface leases

customer_segment.value: B2B: sawmills, pulp and paper mills, log exporters, land buyers, developers, hunting lessees

end_markets.value: forest products; lumber and wood construction; pulp and paper; real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: harvested logs and timber sold under supply agreements or on the open market; project or contract: timberland and real estate parcel sales; rental or leasing: hunting and recreational leases, surface and mineral rights
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: grows and harvests timber on owned and leased land, sold to mills and exporters; asset operator: owns and manages timberlands and land for real estate sales

geography_served.value: global: Timberlands in the US South, Pacific Northwest, and New Zealand, log exports to Asia

specialization.value: related lines: timber harvesting, timberland real estate sales, and land leasing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: logs sold to mills and export marketers under contracts or spot sales; agents / brokers: real estate sales to land buyers and developers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Forestry, environmental and endangered species rules, REIT tax rules from the IRS
